descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-24 ER 1; UAT 3.4 · “Deleted before processing → not included in the summary or note.”. Mixed: stated part — the deleted only row / point is absent from the summary and note; our part — the 1 → 0 count edge and the emptied section reading 'Not dictated' (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S16 Counts 1 → 0: the only medication row and the only Important Point, in both modes; the emptied section reads 'Not dictated', not an invented 'none'

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 A medication row, a task or an Important Point deleted before processing is not included in the summary (the pre-round Save Note result) or in the generated note. (UAT TC-24) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U10 Every TC-24 rule holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home, including deleting a Nursing Home resident. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Hospital patient seeded with exactly one medication row, one Important Point and one task; Nursing Home resident seeded with exactly one medication row and one task

When Hospital: delete the only row and the only point, type the pre-round text and Save Note, then type the encounter text and Generate Note & Finish. Nursing Home: delete the only row, type the visit text, Save & Extract, then Generate Note & Finish.

Then Each emptied section shows no error and none of the deleted text; the summary shows today's lab value. Each note carries today's text, has no deleted item, and its medications section reads 'Not dictated' instead of an invented 'No current medications' or 'None' (3.4).

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U1 with counts at 1 → 0, plus 3.4 for the emptied section. oracle.mjs: no 'pantoprazole', 'NPO after midnight' or 'furosemide' on the summaries or notes; positive controls (oracleRules 1) '9.8' (the extracted lab) on the Hospital summary and 'tolerating diet' / 'eating well' on the notes. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S16 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-24.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
